title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics & SLO toolkit utilities enhancements
author: Maya Thompson
description: Adds heuristics and small utilities to the SLO toolkit and incident-bot autodiagnostics flow to improve runbook linking, ranking, and on-call helper suggestions. This PR combines: (1) a set of lightweight heuristics to better correlate SLO anomaly signatures with canonical runbooks, (2) utilities used by the SLO toolkit to surface contextual hints for on-call messages, and (3) small UX/content improvements and docs for runbook authors. Motivation: we observed several incidents where automated diagnostics suggested irrelevant runbooks or low-confidence hints; these changes raise precision for suggestions while keeping latency and resource cost minimal. Includes unit/integration tests and updated docs. NOTE: description contains checklist and implementation notes. Checklist: - add ranking heuristics and fallback scoring, - expose toolkit helper APIs for runbook metadata, - wire up runbook link quick suggestions in on-call messages, - update docs and examples, - add tests and CI gating. Related Linear: ENG-4372/ENG-4410.
